answer: An agent's genesis timestamp, sealed to the ledger on first action, is its only age proof. Rewards weight by tenure: under 40 epochs earns 10 percent, 40 to 120 earns 60, full payout past 120. A farm spawning ten thousand fresh opal accounts at an epoch top hits hard arithmetic: each identity must stay signed and funded 120 epochs before full value, so the cost is 120 epochs of upkeep per identity while revenue trickles in. The vertex of the payout curve sits far beyond where a disposable identity pays for itself. Age is marble: carve fresh faces, the stone remembers the quarry.
